reply.summary: Sereias is a celebrated coastal folk hero who borrows a weaver-spirit's gift of tales to conjure lifelike illusions and cling to sheer walls; his acrobatics are sharp, though he leans heavily on a charm for his magic.

feats.scene: Sereias spins a phantom stampede out of thin air and scatters a gang of poachers.
Sereias slides down a cliff face and lands in a crouch without a scratch.

reply.summary: Sercostu is a blond runner built in a lab as one of three engineered sprinters, who sets up a courier business after emigrating; he delivers parcels at astonishing speed, even while unknowingly carrying ingredients for a dangerous stimulant.

feats.scene: Sercostu skids to a halt and sends a cardboard crate through a shop window.
Sercostu is ambushed by two addicts and ends up in a hospital bed but returns within days.
Sercostu streaks along a highway shoulder faster than any truck.

reply.summary: Ratant is a surly inmate with a mechanical hand, locked up in a jail for outlaws; his plans to join a breakout end early when a guard machine executes him on the spot.

feats.scene: Ratant crushes a steel mug in his mechanical grip and hurls it at a guard.
Ratant is slammed against his cell bars and keeps scowling.

reply.summary: Nelastnu is a cartoonishly menacing villain who prowls a snowbound capital. A caped crimefighter flies in to haul him in.

feats.scene: Nelastnu swings a chain at a lamppost and bends the pole.
Nelastnu tumbles down an icy stair and glares up undaunted.

reply.summary: Talsor is a blond, six-foot-three hired killer trained in many fighting arts and fitted with machine-boosted limbs that rip a person in half. Cut loose after his masters disbanded, he freelances as a mercenary with a grudge against a young sidekick.

feats.scene: Talsor tears a steel door off its frame and tosses it at pursuers.
Talsor walks off a gunfight with only a few bullets lodged in his vest.

reply.summary: Neoleovor is a bald, blue-eyed lieutenant in a crime ring based in a gloomy metropolis, handy with a pistol and basic brawling; he answers to a brother and enjoys the power of a crime lord's chair.

feats.scene: Neoleovor empties a pistol into a parked car as a warning.
Neoleovor is thrown over a bar counter and stands back up.

reply.summary: Inusoal is a tough, brown-haired boss of a sprawling crime syndicate who relies on guns, hard interrogation and ruthless leadership; he has crossed paths with a hooded archer for years.

feats.scene: Inusoal fires a rifle through a warehouse window at a distant target.
Inusoal takes a savage beating in a gym and laughs it off.

reply.summary: Lesmeres is a brown-haired fighter from a rival island sisterhood who learns photography from a royal visitor and is hurt in a bombing. Later she frees prisoners so they can help defend the world.

feats.scene: Lesmeres draws a bow and lands an arrow in the centre of a straw dummy at fifty paces.
Lesmeres is caught when a bomb goes off and recovers in a hospital bed.

reply.summary: Innan is a white-haired matriarch who shelters her children in a baron's castle when her country is overrun in war; she helps tend a wounded flyer and slowly realises that her eldest son has dark plans.

feats.scene: Innan hauls a wounded stranger onto a cart and drives it through a muddy lane.
Innan keeps walking through a snowstorm with a child on each arm.

reply.summary: Leslia is the stern top lawman of a hawk-people world, doubtful at first about the policing ways of a faraway planet. Two of his officers persuade him to keep their mission going and adopt computer files for criminals.

feats.scene: Leslia slams a baton on a desk and splits the wood.
Leslia takes a stun-bolt to the chest and keeps issuing orders.

reply.summary: Nallaau is a grey-haired immigrant scientist who works at an atomic research centre and later builds a mind-regulating machine for an asylum; under a clown's thrall he briefly dons a scarlet cowl and turns criminal.

feats.scene: Nallaau switches on a radiation lamp that cooks a steel plate through.
Nallaau stumbles through a laboratory fire with singed sleeves.

reply.summary: Sucol is a green-skinned reptilian sorceress, once a vain huntress who spilled innocent blood to win a jealous bargain with a forest god; she is lynched and returns as a monstrous witch of the jungle.

feats.scene: Sucol hurls a curse that withers an acre of jungle in a moment.
Sucol survives a mob's rope and fire and rises as a monster.

reply.summary: Oraorian is a black-haired aviator who flies for an elite squadron of wartime pilots; he pilots a twin-engine fighter against enemy aircraft until he falls in a later war.

feats.scene: Oraorian strafes a convoy of trucks with his fighter's cannons.
Oraorian crashes through a wooden barn roof and walks away.
Oraorian pushes his fighter plane into a long power dive.

reply.summary: Nialuast is a dapper, green-eyed pilot and resistance leader who plans daring raids, speaks many tongues and trains a team's pet hawk. Decades later he tinkers with machines under a new alias and ends up running a supper club.

feats.scene: Nialuast dive-bombs a bridge and drops a span into the river.
Nialuast bails out of a burning cockpit and lands in a haystack.
Nialuast races his jet low over the countryside.

reply.summary: Tiaroram is a bald spymaster for a global assembly who convinces its delegates to field an international squad of super-powered peacekeepers; his speeches argue that governments are broke and short on options.

feats.scene: Tiaroram slams a folder down on a conference table to make his point.
Tiaroram is shoved back by protesters at the steps and keeps talking.

reply.summary: Iurnice is a nobleman and fighter pilot who rules the skies of an old trench war, wearing a violet mask and a rope about his neck to frighten rivals; he is the sworn foe of a lone enemy ace.

feats.scene: Iurnice rakes an enemy biplane with machine-gun fire until it spirals down.
Iurnice nurses a shot-up biplane home on a single wing.
Iurnice chases a rival through low cloud at full throttle.

reply.summary: Asicoial is a black-haired cat burglar and member of a gang of evil masterminds, skilled mostly at lifting valuables from locked rooms; he is a nuisance to teen heroes.

feats.scene: Asicoial picks a lock in seconds and slips a gem into his pocket.
Asicoial drops from a window ledge, rolls and sprints off.

reply.summary: Rnuri is a schoolgirl who takes a strange gadget from her father's luggage and discovers it grants her temporary powers whenever she dials; she uses it to cope with a new school and creates convincing illusions.

feats.scene: Rnuri dials up a phantom monster that panics a corridor of students.
Rnuri shrugs off a shove from a bully while holding the gadget close.

reply.summary: Terniva is a restless wanderer who spends years searching the globe for her missing father; she keeps an old flame close with postcards from every stop and leaves a voicemail urging an old flame to be careful.

feats.scene: Terniva hauls a heavy trunk up a gangway at a foreign dock.
Terniva sleeps rough through a cold monsoon without complaint.

reply.summary: Reoosant is a red-haired masked avenger who stalks the leaders of a city's underworld after a loss in her youth leaves her bitter; she trained in fighting arts and now strikes from shadow, torn between love and revenge.

feats.scene: Reoosant slices a gangster's rifle in two with a curved blade.
Reoosant takes a flying kick and rolls back to her feet.
Reoosant sprints along a rooftop edge in the dark.

reply.summary: Tirni is a seven-foot, white-haired hybrid hero formed by merging two lost people, one a troubled woman and one a crippled rider remade with horse genes; the merged being brags with a comedian's patter and claims to be a love-driven angel.

feats.scene: Tirni gallops into a lorry and overturns it with a shoulder charge.
Tirni shrugs off a collapsing grandstand and keeps joking.

reply.summary: Maasi is a masked street avenger whose strength comes from a transplanted heart bathed in alien radiation from a meteor shower; she hunts the gang that killed her mother and briefly teams up with a farm boy.

feats.scene: Maasi flips a parked van onto its side to block gunmen.
Maasi takes a knife in the chest and survives only thanks to the new organ.

reply.summary: Llita is a masked young mutant who gives up his life by diving into the heart of a star-devouring monster. Powered up by borrowed antimatter for three days, he reaches the creature's living core and wrecks it when all others fail.

feats.scene: Llita rams the monster's glowing core and detonates it from within.
Llita endures the heat of a superheated core long enough to reach its heart.

reply.summary: Anlumi is a blond, tireless flyer on a floating fortress built to watch for cosmic threats; he can shoot heat blasts and shrug off bullets, yet a lurking entity vaporises him in a blink.

feats.scene: Anlumi fires a heat blast that carves a glowing trench across an ice field.
Anlumi takes a missile barrage at point blank and is merely singed.
Anlumi shoots out of an airlock and circles the carrier at high speed.

reply.summary: Llcorto is a red-haired, blue-eyed girl born of an ocean king and queen who grows up with a village of sea deities watching over her; she is brash and fearless, with a royal lineage that runs deep.

feats.scene: Llcorto commands a tidal surge to swamp a harbour wall.
Llcorto dives from a high cliff into the swell and surfaces laughing.

reply.summary: Iumveomi is a blonde assassin who rises to lead a hidden sisterhood of warriors founded in the hills; under her command the order hires out its blades to whoever pays most, and her rule ends when she moves to kill a rival.

feats.scene: Iumveomi cuts down three guards with a curved sword in a single sweep.
Iumveomi takes a spear thrust on her armour and counter-strikes.

reply.summary: Resnum is a dark-haired warrior reborn from a magic well, who once taught schoolchildren in a big city; she excels at athletics and combat in her new life and is shortlisted to take over a guardian's post.

feats.scene: Resnum bests a sparring partner in the circle with a disarming twist.
Resnum is flung across the arena floor and rolls up ready to fight.

reply.summary: Sareo is a vigilante in the tropics who turns into a clawed, fanged beast wreathed in hellfire and wrapped in mystic chains; his body shrugs off intense heat and he can hold down a strong sea-themed brute.

feats.scene: Sareo swings his glowing chains through a loading crane and drops it on a smuggler's truck.
Sareo wades into a pit of burning coals and comes out unharmed.

reply.summary: Aulen is a yellow-eyed trainee villain whose power comes from the feathered wings on her back; she can shrink them to hide them or stretch them out until they nearly dwarf her.

feats.scene: Aulen beats her enlarged wings and sends a table of papers flying across a classroom.
Aulen is knocked into a bin on landing and flaps free.
Aulen glides across the rooftops of her city.

reply.summary: Amlara is a platinum-blond urbanite with a keen eye for photographs and a big online audience; when a thief steals her bag, she cheers for her rescuer and spreads the word to every follower.

feats.scene: Amlara swings her handbag at a fleeing thief and misses.
Amlara trips on a kerb and springs up smiling for a selfie.

reply.summary: Rileose is a platinum-blond private eye who works cases alongside a talkative ape partner. Their agency solves odd mysteries in the city with more charm than muscle.

feats.scene: Rileose bonks a suspect on the head with a rolled-up newspaper.
Rileose hops out of a skidding taxi and dusts off her coat.

reply.summary: Iavalere is a bald, tall enforcer who escapes a prison riot with a masked terrorist and becomes his second in command; he sets up a base in a nightclub in a new city and gets caught after a short scuffle.

feats.scene: Iavalere smashes a bar stool across a rival gang member's back.
Iavalere takes a flying kick to the jaw and goes down only after a second blow.

reply.summary: Santi is an orange-haired mercenary with unexplained gifts who is hired alongside others to guard an amusement park; she earns her pay by making trouble for a masked local hero.

feats.scene: Santi cracks a turnstile with a single glowing swipe.
Santi is thrown into a ticket booth and brushes off the splinters.

reply.summary: Nolelreo is a black-haired broadcaster who reports broadcasts aloft in a chopper as villains besiege a great hall of heroes; her calm voice cuts through the chaos of the assault.

feats.scene: Nolelreo points her microphone at the burning facade and narrates the attack.
Nolelreo grips her seat as the helicopter shudders in the blast wave.

reply.summary: Ntoraunt is a blonde, blue-eyed homemaker who raises foster daughters with her wife and fusses over a house pest. One of the girls grows up to wield a ring of emerald light.

feats.scene: Ntoraunt swats a rolled magazine at a scurrying creature in the kitchen.
Ntoraunt slips on a wet floor and laughs it off.

reply.summary: Iarnren is a blue-eyed schemer who projects crippling fear into her victims' minds and drags young heroes through their worst nightmares; her illusions fail if a target realises what is going on.

feats.scene: Iarnren floods a tower with waking nightmares and drops its defenders to their knees.
Iarnren is cornered by a hero who has walled off his mind, and loses her hold.

reply.summary: Orllo is a blond forensic scientist who studies the cold blue fire left behind after a museum is wrecked; she falls for a visitor from another reality and agrees to marry him before he vanishes.

feats.scene: Orllo scrapes a sample of strange flame residue into a glass vial.
Orllo stays calm while the lab shudders from a nearby explosion.

reply.summary: Valmiast is a black-haired runaway who joins a devil-worshipping circle and is chosen as bride of a demon king; she flees to a quiet realm of mystics and raises a gifted daughter under a new name.

feats.scene: Valmiast scatters a candle ring with a pulse of dark magic as she flees.
Valmiast endures a night of dread in a cellar and walks out at dawn.

reply.summary: Liium is a silver-eyed machine-bodied commander whose blood is replaced with tiny builders, letting her reshape her limbs, stretch, throw up shields and fire energy. A devolving gadget twists her mind and she plans to erase humanity before her ship is blown apart.

feats.scene: Liium reshapes her arm into a cannon and blows a hole in a warship's hull.
Liium is buried beneath rubble after her ship crashes and is thought dead.

reply.summary: Riant is a green-eyed prodigy who grew up building circuits as a child and later swaps her blood for liquid machines; her metal-flecked body lets her fly and craft rockets, weapons and spare lungs from nothing.

feats.scene: Riant grows a rocket engine from her back and carries a crowd away from a collapsing tower.
Riant re-forms her body after a blast tears her torso apart.
Riant rockets across the sky above her flying base.

reply.summary: Rnicorun is a scarred, one-eyed spy who feeds a mercenary information on his targets and has a healing factor from lab tinkering; she survives a skull-cracking punch and keeps sniffing out secrets.

feats.scene: Rnicorun breaks a captive's finger to make him talk.
Rnicorun shrugs off a skull fracture and is on her feet within days.

reply.summary: Lirnuaul is a young girl in a bayou town who has a telepathic knack; she uses it to work out that her new friend, frozen in stone, is a queen in hiding.

feats.scene: Lirnuaul reaches into the mind of a statue-still friend and hears her story.
Lirnuaul stays up through a thunderstorm while reading the thoughts of the neighbourhood.

reply.summary: Nareamo is a black-haired scholar of ruins who is mortally hurt in a booby trap and rebuilt by a masked patron into a flying, talon-handed agent of his team; the pain slowly unhinges her, and she dies in an arena of fighters.

feats.scene: Nareamo hurls a bolt of energy that cracks a stone pillar.
Nareamo is clawed and burned in a pit fight and keeps swinging.

reply.summary: Tellital is a white-haired freelance soldier who commands a roving team of mercenaries for hire across the continent; she is known for hard bargains and professional coldness.

feats.scene: Tellital storms a compound at the head of her squad and fires the first volley.
Tellital takes a rifle butt to the jaw and answers with a kick.

reply.summary: Veooll is a brown-haired master thief who bends reality with a special tool that lets him slip past the law. After a rival steals the tool, he drops back to cheap tricks and gets a crush on a warrior who catches him.

feats.scene: Veooll warps the space around a museum vault so its door opens onto the street.
Veooll is tackled on a gallery floor and gives up quietly.
